messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need a lean cadence for the product teaser across X + LinkedIn next week. thinking micro-bursts (tease -> explain -> webinar CTA) rather than a long single thread. who can own assets and scheduling? :spiral_calendar:

sanjay: I like micro-bursts. propose: Day 0 tease (short hook), Day 1 feature thread (carousel/slide on LI), Day 2 webinar invite + registration CTA. X gets short quick hits, LI gets a long-form post + carousel. timeline ok? :+1:

olivia: I can assemble assets. need hero GIF, 3 static slides for LI, and 2 GIFs sized for X. can we lock copy by EOD Friday?

maya: Lock by EOD Fri works. olivia — can you add a simple template for copy so growth can A/B? sample below: 
```
Tease (X): "Something that makes inference cheap + fast is arriving. Join the early peeks. RSVP: <link>"
LI long: "We built a platform to make inference predictable across cloud, dedicated, and private fleets. Join our webinar to see how teams cut latency and cost. RSVP: <link>"
```

james (growth): I can run small paid tests for the Day 2 CTA (USA/UK). budget ask: $1.5k to start split across X/LI. need finalized copy + landing URL by Mon 10am PT. also want tracking params: `utm_source=social&utm_campaign=teaser_mar`

samira: For inbound routing: please add `?src=social-tease` on the registration link. I'll route leads: >50 signups -> SDR queue, <50 -> nurture drip. Also need to know if any customers are being mentioned (legal check).

olivia: Not using customer names in teaser. will deliver assets: hero.gif (1200x675), LI_carousel_1-3.png, X_gif_1.gif, X_gif_2.gif by Fri 3pm PT. posting copy variants v1/v2 included in the drive folder: https://drive.redwood.example/teaser-assets

maya: scheduling rules: pin primary CTA at best times. quick schedule suggestion from Sanjay: 
```
- X: Day 0 09:00 PT (tease), 12:00 PT (reminder)
- LI: Day 1 11:00 PT (long post + carousel)
- X: Day 2 09:00 PT (webinar CTA)
```
Keep cadence to 2-3 posts/day max.

sanjay: For threads on X, we should rotate the lead sentence and image to avoid platform suppression. also try one post as a short video (5-8s) for higher engagement.

james (growth): I'll set up the campaigns once copy + final assets are in drive. ping me when folder updated and I'll confirm ad creative specs.

samira: I'll drop a quick routing doc in the ops folder and wire the webhook to the form. want to test 1 signup flow before live. can someone do a quick submit test on Mon?

olivia: Yep, will QA the form + visuals Mon 9am PT.

social-bot: Reminder: weekly calendar slot booked for launch coordination — Mon 10:30 PT in #marketing. :robot_face:

maya: checklist to close: 
- [ ] finalize copy variants (maya/james) by Mon 10am PT
- [ ] assets in drive (olivia) by Fri 3pm PT
- [ ] QA submit + routing test (olivia/samira) Mon 9am PT
- [ ] ad campaign setup (james) after assets locked
- [ ] tracking params and landing URL confirmed (james/samira)

sanjay: Love it. small note — add one soft follow-up 48 hours post-webinar for reengagement.

maya: Added. thanks everyone! :rocket:
